en: A black‑and‑white street scene showing a gently sloping road lined with wooden and masonry buildings. People walk along the sidewalks, some with children, while bicycles are parked against a building on the right. In the distance are low hills or mountains under a clear sky. Printed text at the bottom left identifies the scene as a street in Kiruna, and a photographer/publisher credit appears at the bottom right.
